brief: A suspected Islamist terror attack at Berlin Pride leaves one dead and 16 injured, while wildfires in France and Spain drive hundreds of thousands from their homes. New research explores usability of conversational AI, AR for deaf students, and ethical AI in dementia care.
news_summary: Berlin Pride car attack kills one, injures 16; suspect linked to Islamist circles. Wildfires in France and Spain force over 300,000 to evacuate, with at least one death.
papers_summary: Studies examine AI transparency in product advisors, AR accessibility for deaf students, and ethical generative AI for social connectedness in dementia care.

zh.brief: 今日焦点：柏林同志骄傲游行遭汽车冲撞，疑似恐怖袭击致1死16伤；法国和西班牙野火迫使数十万人疏散；另有一项研究显示，短暂训练可帮助人类识别AI生成的面孔。
zh.news_summary: 柏林同志骄傲游行中一辆汽车冲入人群，造成至少1死16伤，警方锁定一名与伊斯兰圈子有关的嫌疑人，疑似恐怖袭击。法国和西班牙野火导致超过30万人疏散，西班牙总理警告未来数小时严峻。此外，BBC报道称人类可通过一小时训练提高识别AI生成面孔的能力。
zh.papers_summary: 今日优先论文空缺，但英文论文涵盖AI辅助创意写作、AR无障碍、临床工作流优化等主题。
